purpose.statement: DataProgram is a called COBOL subprogram that manages a single in-memory account balance. It accepts an operation type and a balance value via the LINKAGE SECTION and either reads the internally stored balance out to the caller or writes a new balance supplied by the caller into internal working storage. It is designed to be invoked by a parent program rather than run standalone.

code_references.snippet:
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PASSED-OPERATION BALANCE.
           MOVE PASSED-OPERATION TO OPERATION-TYPE

           IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'READ'
               MOVE STORAGE-BALANCE TO BALANCE

           ELSE IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'WRITE'
               MOVE BALANCE TO STORAGE-BALANCE

           END-IF
           GOBACK.

business_rules.statement: The program supports exactly two operation types: 'READ' and 'WRITE'. Any value passed in PASSED-OPERATION that is neither 'READ' nor 'WRITE' results in no action being taken; the balance is neither read nor updated, and no error is raised.

code_references.snippet:
IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'READ'
               MOVE STORAGE-BALANCE TO BALANCE

           ELSE IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'WRITE'
               MOVE BALANCE TO STORAGE-BALANCE

           END-IF

business_rules.statement: When the operation type is 'READ', the program returns the current internally held balance (STORAGE-BALANCE) to the caller by moving it into the BALANCE linkage parameter. This is a non-destructive read; STORAGE-BALANCE is unchanged.

code_references.snippet:
IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'READ'
               MOVE STORAGE-BALANCE TO BALANCE

business_rules.statement: When the operation type is 'WRITE', the program accepts the balance value supplied by the caller via the BALANCE linkage parameter and overwrites the internally stored balance (STORAGE-BALANCE) with it.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'WRITE'
               MOVE BALANCE TO STORAGE-BALANCE

business_rules.statement: The initial default value of the internally stored balance is 1000.00. This is a hard-coded seed value and represents the starting account balance before any WRITE operation is performed.

The balance field is defined as a numeric packed value with up to 6 integer digits and 2 decimal places (PIC 9(6)V99), enforcing a maximum storable balance of 999999.99 and a minimum of 0.00. Negative balances are not representable by this data type.

The operation type is limited to 6 characters (PIC X(6)), meaning values passed by the caller are silently truncated or padded with spaces to 6 characters before comparison. The comparisons are against the literal strings 'READ  ' (space-padded) and 'WRITE ' (space-padded) as implied by fixed-length alphanumeric comparison semantics.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PASSED-OPERATION TO OPERATION-TYPE

           IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'READ'
               MOVE STORAGE-BALANCE TO BALANCE

           ELSE IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'WRITE'
               MOVE BALANCE TO STORAGE-BALANCE

inputs.statement: PASSED-OPERATION: A 6-character alphanumeric value passed by the calling program through the LINKAGE SECTION. It specifies the operation to perform ('READ' or 'WRITE') and drives all branching logic in the program.

code_references.snippet:
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PASSED-OPERATION BALANCE.
           MOVE PASSED-OPERATION TO OPERATION-TYPE

inputs.statement: BALANCE (on WRITE): When the caller passes operation type 'WRITE', the BALANCE linkage parameter acts as an input carrying the new balance value to be stored internally.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'WRITE'
               MOVE BALANCE TO STORAGE-BALANCE

outputs.statement: BALANCE (on READ): When the caller passes operation type 'READ', the BALANCE linkage parameter acts as an output, returning the current value of STORAGE-BALANCE to the calling program.

code_references.snippet:
IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'READ'
               MOVE STORAGE-BALANCE TO BALANCE

outputs.statement: STORAGE-BALANCE (internal state): An internal working-storage field that persists the balance value between calls within the same program load. It is updated on WRITE operations and sourced on READ operations.

processing_logic.statement: Step 1 – Entry and parameter receipt: The program is entered via PROCEDURE DIVISION USING, receiving two parameters from the caller: PASSED-OPERATION (the operation code) and BALANCE (the balance value, used as input or output depending on the operation).

Step 2 – Operation type resolution: The caller-supplied operation code PASSED-OPERATION is moved into the internal working-storage field OPERATION-TYPE, making it available for conditional evaluation.

Step 3 – READ branch: If OPERATION-TYPE equals 'READ', the program copies the current internally held STORAGE-BALANCE into the caller's BALANCE linkage field, effectively returning the stored balance to the caller.

code_references.snippet:
IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'READ'
               MOVE STORAGE-BALANCE TO BALANCE

processing_logic.statement: Step 4 – WRITE branch: If OPERATION-TYPE equals 'WRITE', the program copies the caller-supplied BALANCE value into STORAGE-BALANCE, updating the internally held balance.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'WRITE'
               MOVE BALANCE TO STORAGE-BALANCE

processing_logic.statement: Step 5 – Termination: After the conditional logic completes (or is bypassed for an unrecognized operation type), the program returns control to the calling program via GOBACK, passing back the (potentially updated) BALANCE linkage field.

dependencies.statement: Calling program (unknown): DataProgram has no CALL statements of its own and contains no copybooks or external references. It is entirely dependent on a parent/calling program to invoke it via a CALL statement, supply valid values for PASSED-OPERATION and BALANCE, and interpret the returned BALANCE value. The identity of the calling program is not specified within this source file.

error_handling.statement: There is no explicit error handling in this program. Unrecognized operation types (values other than 'READ' or 'WRITE') cause the conditional block to be skipped entirely with no error flag set, no error message produced, no abend triggered, and no indication returned to the caller that the operation was invalid.

code_references.snippet:
IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'READ'
               MOVE STORAGE-BALANCE TO BALANCE

           ELSE IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'WRITE'
               MOVE BALANCE TO STORAGE-BALANCE

           END-IF
           GOBACK.

error_handling.statement: There is no overflow or range validation on the BALANCE or STORAGE-BALANCE fields. If the caller supplies a value exceeding PIC 9(6)V99 capacity (i.e., greater than 999,999.99), the result is undefined and runtime-dependent (potential truncation or abend), as no ON SIZE ERROR clause or validation logic is present.

downstream_effects.statement: The calling program receives the current stored balance in its BALANCE parameter after a READ operation. Any business logic in the caller that depends on the balance value (e.g., transaction authorization, reporting, display) is directly affected by the value held in STORAGE-BALANCE at the time of the call.

code_references.snippet:
IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'READ'
               MOVE STORAGE-BALANCE TO BALANCE

downstream_effects.statement: After a WRITE operation, the internal STORAGE-BALANCE is updated. Any subsequent READ calls (within the same program load/session) by any caller will receive the newly written balance value, meaning WRITE operations have a stateful, session-scoped downstream effect on all future READ results.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE IF OPERATION-TYPE = 'WRITE'
               MOVE BALANCE TO STORAGE-BALANCE

downstream_effects.statement: Because the balance is stored only in WORKING-STORAGE (in-memory), it is not persisted to any file, database, or external storage. Any downstream system expecting durable balance persistence will not receive it from this program; the balance resets to 1000.00 each time the program is freshly loaded into memory.

code_references.snippet:
DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  STORAGE-BALANCE    PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 1000.00.
       01  OPERATION-TYPE     PIC X(6).

       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  PASSED-OPERATION   PIC X(6).
       01  BALANCE            PIC 9(6)V99.
